name: Banjarmasin
registryBasis: Banjarmasin has an official ATR/BPN municipal land office. ATR/BPN’s national BHUMI documentation describes an interactive public geospatial platform whose main datasets include land parcels, but its first-use disclaimer must be accepted and no city-specific anonymous parcel schema or geometry was verified in this review. The city’s SIGAP asset inventory concerns government assets, not the complete cadastral fabric.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No city-scoped public parcel layer, safe field schema or full geometry response was verified in BHUMI. The local ATR/BPN office confirms land administration, while SIGAP covers municipal assets. The public first-use disclaimer is informational and is not an automatic eligibility gate.
scopeLimits: Banjarmasin-specific registry basis is the official municipal ATR/BPN office. BHUMI is national and its presence does not establish local coverage or a query contract. SIGAP is a public inventory of government assets only.
remainingUncertainty: The local ATR/BPN page is an application shell. BHUMI documentation indicates land-parcel layers exist nationally, but the initial-use disclaimer has not been accepted and no anonymous city-specific geometry/schema route was verified. Runtime remains disabled.

officialSources.observation: Official ATR/BPN Banjarmasin land-office application; public HTML says JavaScript is needed, and no parcel endpoint or schema was exposed by the inspected page.

Official BHUMI help says the platform is an open geospatial land/planning viewer; an initial disclaimer must be agreed to continue and warns information may be incomplete or outdated and that official use requires an information request.
Official help describes a geospatial data catalog and lists land parcels among the main BHUMI datasets; help page does not publish a city-specific parcel schema or service endpoint.
Official city SIGAP portal inventories municipal/government assets; this scope is not equivalent to all cadastral parcels.
